title: 🌱 "Google" Launches "Momentum" to Support Indian Startups with AI
body: 🌱 "Google" Launches "Momentum" to Support Indian Startups with AI

Google announced a new initiative called "Momentum", designed to give startups in India everything they need to grow: AI models, engineering expertise, cloud infrastructure, and access to global markets.
The initiative builds on a full decade of startup accelerator programs in India, which have supported 277 startups so far — and 94% of their graduates are still building and expanding today.

The company gave live examples of what AI can do: a health startup screened more than 160,000 patients across more than 20 Indian states using AI to check hearts — even without an internet connection.
In the legal field, one company cut response time by 70% and processing costs by 80% after weaving AI models into contract management.

Support is not limited to big companies — it also reaches companies building small AI models that run offline and support more than 200 languages and dialects, and others developed inside a prestigious Indian university to build local models in Indian languages.
Simply put: Google does not just sell AI tools; it walks alongside small companies step by step until their ideas become real products that reach the whole world.
Could an initiative like this change the future of startups in your country?
